Winter event on {wiki:Percht Island}, reached by a boat near the port of Svargrond. You gather three percht parts to make a disguise, enter the frozen hall and thaw {creature:The Percht Queen} with bonfires and Warm Fires before killing her. You get the Percht Raider outfit (and addons in later years), access to the sleigh mounts and, at the end of the event, all worlds receive a week of double respawn and regeneration.
Boat to Percht Island, Svargrond port
Percht sleigh mounts (Dark, Bright and Cold Percht Sleigh)
After taking part in the event once; with 2 and 3 participations you can upgrade them to the next variants.
You pay with {item:Percht Skull|Percht Skulls}: 3 for the first sleighs and 1 per mount for each upgrade.
The boat near the Svargrond harbour
